source: There are reckonings for the souls of places. Bombastic reckonings, like the American Civil War, can shape entire nations. Quiet reckonings, like grudges between loved ones, can forever change a home. Somewhere in the middle is a town, a place with a collective soul that is tested by a changing the world. With blood blended in its water, Daisy Pond saw a reckoning for the soul of its town. And as with all reckonings, a path forward becomes clear.
target: 地方的靈魂，也有清算的時刻。轟轟烈烈的清算，如美國南北戰爭，能塑造整個國家。悄無聲息的清算，如摯愛之間的怨懟，能永遠改變一個家。介於兩者之間的，是一座城鎮，一個擁有共同靈魂、接受變動世界考驗的地方。鮮血融入池水，雛菊池見證了這座鎮子靈魂的清算。如同所有清算，前方的道路，也因此清晰。

source: RECKONINGS
target: 清算

source: MUCK
target: 污泥

source: By the light of the moon the reeking, wretched cart returns. Excrement drips off of putrid barrels as the horse pulls up to the swamp of fetid muck for another delivery. The local night soil man has emptied another home’s privy and brings it to the dumping ground, this forgotten swamp, away from polite society. His business is booming. There is always waste to clear in a growing town yet without sewers. He wraps his face in a thick cotton rag and he dumps the barrels of filth into the muck. He doesn’t believe his father. It can’t be here that his old man joined the Johnny Trackers to whoop the hooded bigots straight out of town. No, a glorious place like Daisy Pond could never turn into such a cesspool, could it?
target: 月光下，那輛惡臭不堪的馬車又回來了。糞便從腐臭的木桶滴落，馬匹拉著車來到污泥沼澤，送來又一車穢物。本地挑糞人清空了另一戶人家的茅廁，將糞便運到這處傾倒場，這片遠離體面社會、遭人遺忘的沼澤。他生意興隆。城鎮不斷成長，卻還沒有下水道，永遠有穢物要清。他用厚棉布包住臉，把一桶桶污物倒進泥沼。他不相信父親的話。老頭子當年加入強尼追蹤者，把那些戴頭罩的偏執狂打出鎮外，怎麼可能就是在這裡？不，雛菊池那麼光榮的地方，怎麼可能變成這種糞坑，對吧？

source: REEF BENEATH
target: 水下的礁

source: Aslandians don’t know how or when the oysters arrived. The bivalve mollusks spawned rapidly, clinging to the SMEED concrete structures flooded by the shallow sea. Their new homes -- plenty sturdy to support countless families of bone-hard shells that grow heavier with age. Within a year, the vibrant beginnings of a vast reef had formed under the rope bridges and pine docks that connected the stilted huts of the people above. A nursery soon flourished for crabs, shrimp, herring, and bass. Then a complex ecosystem emerged that attracted mackerel and seals. No one knows what brought the oysters that started it all, but before eating them an Aslandian always whispers a quick prayer: "Thank you SMEED that gives us feed."
target: 阿斯蘭迪亞人不知道牡蠣如何、何時來到這裡。這些雙殼軟體動物迅速繁殖，附著在遭淺海淹沒的斯米德混凝土建築上。新家十分堅固，足以承載無數家庭；牠們的殼硬如骨，隨年歲愈長愈沉。一年之內，連接上方高腳屋的繩橋與松木碼頭下，已形成一片生機蓬勃的巨大礁群雛形。螃蟹、蝦、鯡魚與鱸魚的育幼場很快興盛起來。接著，複雜的生態系吸引了鯖魚與海豹。沒人知道，是什麼帶來了開啟這一切的牡蠣，但阿斯蘭迪亞人吃牠們之前，總會輕聲念一句簡短禱詞：「感謝斯米德，讓我們有得吃。」

source: Nobody likes pearls. When a grain of sand or other miniscule irritant nestles between an oyster’s shell and the meaty tissue that connects to it, the oyster obsesses with reducing the irritation by constantly coating it in nacre – the iridescent composite that forms its shell, and grows the pearl inside. For an oyster, life with a pearl is life without peace. No better are pearls for the people of the shallow sea who feed on oyster meat. Pearls are the main cause of cracked and chipped teeth. Too small to even serves as marbles for children, these lustrous, annoying beads are tossed back into the water. Laughable to think they were ever prized!
target: 沒人喜歡珍珠。當一粒沙，或其他極小的異物，卡進牡蠣的殼與相連的肉質組織之間，牡蠣便執著於減輕刺激，不斷分泌珍珠母包覆它——那是構成貝殼、帶有虹彩的複合物，也讓殼內的珍珠愈長愈大。對牡蠣而言，有珍珠的日子，就是不得安寧的日子。對以牡蠣肉為食的淺海居民，珍珠也沒比較好。它們是牙齒裂開、崩缺的主要原因。這些光亮惱人的小珠子，小到連給孩子當彈珠都不行，只能丟回水裡。想到它們竟曾是珍寶，真可笑！

source: PRETTY ANNYOING
target: 美麗的麻煩

source: RUNNING OF THE BULL
target: 奔逃避雄獸

source: When a boy turns 13 and wants to be a seal hunter or oyster diver, the older teens training for these roles take the boy to Seal Island for a ritual of bravery. All during seal breeding season, when the two-ton elephant seals are particularly aggressive. The ritual commences soon after dawn. The boy must sneak his way through the snoring mass of elephant seals, slap the biggest bull on the beach and escape the startled, roaring frenzy back to the canoe. When they see the slap, the older teens beat on pots and yell themselves hoarse on the shore, frothing up as many seals as possible for the young aspirant to juke and dodge on his sprint back to the safety of the canoe. Each year, the cacophony echoes all the way to Aslandia and wakes the tribe. The elders admonish the older teens upon their return and, as is customary, the brave boy receives his first hunting knife.
target: 男孩滿十三歲，若想成為海豹獵人或潛水採蠔人，正在受訓的年長少年便會帶他到海豹島，接受勇氣儀式。這一切都選在海豹繁殖季進行，正值兩噸重的象鼻海豹格外兇猛的時候。儀式在黎明後不久開始。男孩必須悄悄穿過鼾聲四起的象鼻海豹群，拍打海灘上最大的雄獸，再從受驚咆哮的混亂中，逃回獨木舟。看見他拍下去，年長少年便在岸上敲鍋、喊到聲嘶力竭，盡可能激怒更多海豹，讓這位年輕新手在奔回獨木舟的路上閃躲穿梭。每年，喧鬧聲都一路傳到阿斯蘭迪亞，喚醒整個部落。眾人回來後，長老會訓斥年長少年；而依照慣例，勇敢的男孩會得到人生第一把獵刀。

source: MUSEUM OF SOULS
target: 靈魂博物館

source: An old stone marker there, from when Bancroft was but a Puritan’s hamlet, laments the conflict between the earliest settlers and the natives of the land. Another grave boasts ornately carved granite, stags flanking a French crest above the name of a wealthy fur trader. Then rows of commoners – the lifeblood of town – with their pine crosses and crude bronze plaques that could afford little more than five words: “James Tyber – Father. Weaver. Beloved.” A sculpted lamb laying on a stone slab watches over a plot for siblings, its gaze bent towards “pox” of all words. As slowly as it does surely, this quiet museum grows its exhibit of souls.
target: 那邊一塊古老石碑，立於班克羅夫特還只是清教徒小村的年代，哀悼最早移民與原住民之間的衝突。另一座墓以雕工華麗的花崗岩自豪，雄鹿分立法國紋章兩側，下方刻著富裕皮草商的名字。接著，是一排排平民——鎮子的命脈——豎著松木十字架與粗糙銅牌，僅勉強付得起幾個字：「詹姆斯・泰伯——父親。織工。摯愛。」一尊臥在石板上的羔羊雕像，守望著一對手足的墓地，目光偏偏落在「痘疫」二字上。這座寧靜博物館，緩慢而確實地，擴增著它的靈魂展覽。

source: CONVENIENT IDOLS
target: 方便的偶像

source: Not every town can claim to have a hero, especially one with such a valiant legend as Nathaniel “Deathless” Asbury – freedom fighter of the pines turned venerated mayor. The locals claimed him hungrily after death.  Chosen for immortality, Old Deathless rests beneath a mighty marble slab and marker in the middle of the cemetery. Four bodies exhumed and moved to fit his grave and the little garden around it. Would he be revered so deeply, honored so intently if they knew not whom he fought, but rather whom he loved? How he loved? As if there is a right way…
target: 不是每座城鎮都能宣稱自己有英雄，更別說像納撒尼爾「不死者」阿斯伯里這般英勇傳奇的人物——松林中的自由戰士，後來成為備受尊崇的鎮長。他死後，當地人迫不及待將他據為己有。被選中永垂不朽的老不死者，長眠於墓園中央巨大的大理石墓板與墓碑之下。為了容納他的墓與周圍小花園，四具遺體遭挖出遷走。若人們知道的，不是他與誰交戰，而是他愛過誰、如何去愛，還會如此崇敬、如此隆重地紀念他嗎？彷彿愛有什麼正確方式似的……

source: Each year before the Christmas months, townsfolk invade the shrublands on holiday hunts for wild turkey. They arrive with the confidence of lions, families in tow, with one hand toting the Sunday shotgun packed with pellets and powder and the other heaving a picnic basket filled with cheeses, apples, ale, and biscuits. As the day wears on, frustration sets in. Who knew gobblers could be so astute? Indeed, every miniscule movement sends them scurrying away. The cock of a gun, the delicate crunch of a twig, an airy sigh from the wife – the large bird flees. Patience loses, and the fair-weather fowl hunters head home humbled, knowing they’ll be buying their gobbler from that whiskey-soaked Mr. Quail. He’s just a lucky shot. Has to be.
target: 每年耶誕節前的幾個月，鎮民湧入灌木地，展開節慶火雞狩獵。他們帶著獅子般的自信、拖著全家出發，一手提著裝滿彈丸與火藥的假日獵槍，一手拎著裝有起司、蘋果、麥酒與比司吉的野餐籃。日子慢慢過去，挫折感開始浮現。誰知道火雞竟如此精明？沒錯，任何微小動靜都讓牠們拔腿逃走。槍機一響、樹枝輕輕一裂、妻子幽幽一嘆——大鳥就跑了。耐心耗盡，這些偶爾出馬的獵禽者，灰頭土臉地回家，明白自己終究得向那位泡在威士忌裡的奎爾先生買火雞。他只是運氣好，碰巧打中罷了。一定是。

source: HOLIDAY HUNTING
target: 節慶狩獵

source: The irony of a bunker is that it’s supposed to protect you from the tomb, but it can easily become one. Preserving perfectly the last moments of life and all that surrounded it. But here is ransacked. Broken equipment, scattered documents, wrecked shelves, overturned tables, stained cement floors and bullet-chipped walls. The overwhelming smell of musky rot. And yet, secrets of the past abound. Leisure reading filled with the cravings of a society, and the inventions that sate them. Even a powerful weapon. The one that gets an entire Constitutional Amendment. Beloved like a good car. This six-shooter is flourishingly inscribed with “Maggie.” It still glints in the sunlight, as if it still had a little breath left. Just one more shot.
target: 碉堡的諷刺之處，在於它本該保護你免入墳墓，自己卻很容易成為墳墓。完美保存生命最後的時刻，以及當時周遭的一切。但這裡遭到洗劫。損壞的設備、散落的文件、毀壞的層架、翻倒的桌子、髒污的水泥地，以及被子彈打缺的牆面。濃烈的潮腐氣味撲鼻而來。可是，過去的祕密仍俯拾皆是。消遣讀物裡，滿是某個社會的渴望，以及滿足渴望的發明。甚至還有一把威力強大的武器。那種有整條憲法修正案保障的武器。像好車一樣受人鍾愛。這把六發左輪上，以華麗字體刻著「瑪姬」。它仍在陽光下閃耀，彷彿還剩最後一口氣。再開一槍。

source: ACCIDENTAL TIME CAPSULE
target: 意外的時光膠囊

source: Displaced Aslandians find themselves at the bottom of the social order, clustered together in the mud at the edge of a strange snail society. Unlike other wild tribes, they are not slaughtered or enslaved by the Snail Legions. No, they are different from the usual savages. Resourceful and pragmatic, these people are given a chance to work for the Snail Lords who sit atop their shelled mounts in splendid purple capes and golden boots. The Aslandians, assimilated into the Mudfoot class, are allowed their own part of the city, where they may grapple between the forces of survival and exploitation.
target: 流離失所的阿斯蘭迪亞人，發現自己落在社會最底層，聚居於這個奇異蝸牛社會邊緣的泥地。與其他野外部落不同，他們沒有遭蝸牛軍團屠殺或奴役。不，他們不同於尋常野蠻人。他們機靈、務實，因此獲准替蝸領主工作；那些領主披著華麗紫斗篷、穿金靴，端坐有殼的坐騎之上。被納入泥足民階級的阿斯蘭迪亞人，獲分配城中一角，在生存與剝削的拉扯間掙扎。

source: A LESSER HOME
target: 低人一等的家

source: The Mudfoot bleed for Zeethe. Z-dust, the zee, true blue, dry high. Alleys and side roads hold groups of wild-eyed wretches who babble paranoid monologues and, in the worst cases, lash out. If the Snail Guards are called in, they don’t even dismount from their shell saddles as they spear through anyone who seems hysterical – “dangers to common order.” They spear through brothers and sisters, fathers and mothers. The tormented become more tormented. The desperate become more desperate. In all this, a euphoric feeling, even from chemicals, can seem like hope. Just as intended.
target: 泥足民為齊斯流血。Z 粉、小齊、真藍、乾飄。巷弄與小路上，聚著一群群眼神狂亂的可憐人，喃喃說著多疑的獨白，嚴重時還會動手攻擊。若召來蝸牛衛兵，他們甚至不必下鞍，就直接用長矛刺穿任何看似歇斯底里的人——「公共秩序的威脅」。刺穿兄弟姊妹、父親母親。受折磨的人更加痛苦，絕望的人更加絕望。在這一切之中，一點欣快感，即使來自化學藥物，也能像是希望。正如計畫所願。

source: PLANNED DEMOLITION
target: 計畫性的摧毀

source: Beside the pine forest, migrating settlers find treeless lands. Meadows of tall, many-flowered grasses that sustain an ecosystem of insects, songbirds, rodents, deer, buffalo and coyotes alike. All of it springing from deep fertile soil. All of it slowly unwinding as soon as settlers arrive.
target: 松林旁，遷徙的移民發現了沒有樹的土地。高草與繁花交織的草甸，支撐著昆蟲、鳴禽、齧齒動物、鹿、野牛與郊狼共存的生態系。一切都從深厚肥沃的土壤萌生。一切也在移民抵達的那一刻，開始緩緩瓦解。

source: INVASIVE SPECIES
target: 入侵物種

source: The Cherokee people of the region believed it is a unique event to see the white raccoon, a spiritual being that present itself to humans only when it wants to be seen. For the elders who tell the story of her legend, they believe this cloud-white animal is the spirit of Unega Long-Spirit keeping the land fertile and the game fat. For parents with rambunctious children, the white raccoon is the clever trickster that lures misbehaving boys and girls to the dens of coyotes and wolves. Whatever its purpose, the white raccoon remains a part of life in the grasses and woods, from one generation to the next.
target: 本地切羅基人相信，看見白浣熊是非比尋常的事。那是一種靈性存在，只有在牠願意被看見時，才會現身人前。講述其傳說的長者相信，這隻白如雲朵的動物，是尤內加・長靈的靈魂，使土地肥沃、獵物肥美。對家有頑童的父母而言，白浣熊是狡黠的惡作劇者，會把不聽話的孩子引到郊狼與狼的巢穴。不管牠的目的為何，白浣熊始終是草地與樹林生活的一部分，一代傳向一代。

source: SPIRITED STORIES
target: 有靈的故事

source: CHORUS OF THE FOREST
target: 森林的合唱

source: The Aspen trees chatter amongst themselves. A constant discussion about the world happening around them, to them. From pondering the patterns on a moth’s wings to mourning a storm-felled sibling, streams and streams of reflection and conversation flow endlessly across their web of shared roots. For the rest of us, only when the wind shakes their leaves can we hear the Aspen chorus, a thousand voices of a forest chirring like an ancient beast.
target: 白楊樹彼此交談。不停討論身邊發生、落到自己身上的世界。從思索飛蛾翅膀的紋路，到哀悼被暴風折倒的手足，一道道思緒與對話，沿著共用的根網無盡流淌。對我們其餘的生命而言，只有風吹動葉片時，才聽得見白楊的合唱——整座森林的千百個聲音，像遠古巨獸般沙沙低鳴。

source: The Aspen appears indomitable. Their bark is photosynethic, allowing growth even in the frosty months after they have shed their leaves. Because oftheir depth in the ground, Aspen root systems can easily survive the heat of forest fires and rapidly begin shooting up new trunks for every one that dies. Acres of Aspen can sprout rapidly after a land-clearing calamity. Even the tree leaves have uniquely adapted to decrease aerodynamic drag against great winds that threaten their stability. Yet, all things mighty bear a weakness. The Aspen’s is as simple as shade.
target: 白楊彷彿無法被擊敗。樹皮能行光合作用，即使落葉後的寒霜月份，也能繼續生長。根系深埋地下，輕易熬過森林大火的高熱，每一根死去的樹幹，都能迅速長出新幹取代。清空土地的災難過後，成片白楊能迅速萌生。就連葉片也有獨特適應，能減少威脅樹木穩固的強風所帶來的空氣阻力。然而，再強大的事物都有弱點。白楊的弱點，簡單得只是陰影。

source: MIGHTY WEAKNESS
target: 強者的弱點
